Delegation.description: A root-signed delegation to a short-lived key (spec 3.5 §7.2).

kid.description: Key id of the delegated key.

proof.description: The root key's detached JWS over the JCS form of the delegation without `proof`.

scopes.description: What the delegated key may sign.

KeyScope.description: What a delegated key may sign (spec 3.5 §7.2).

oneOf.description: Site log checkpoints, and through them release manifests.

Documents the edge issues: commerce receipts, consent receipts, site status, stream
entries and quotes.
Quotes and payment mandates presented to a rail.

Proof.description:
A detached JWS (spec 3.5 §7.2).

`jws` is the compact serialization with an empty payload; the signed payload is the JCS
form of the enclosing document without its `proof`.

kid.description: Key id of the signing key in `keys.json`.

PublicKeyJwk.description: An Ed25519 public key as a JWK (RFC 8037) (spec 3.5 §7.2).

x.description: The public key, base64url without padding.

RetiredRoot.description: An earlier root key, kept after a rotation (spec 3.5 §7.2).

retiredAt.description: When it stopped being the root.

Revocation.description:
A root-signed withdrawal of a delegated key (spec 3.5 §7.2).

A signature by the key on a document dated at or after `revokedAt`, or on any live
document, is rejected.

kid.description: Key id of the revoked key.

proof.description: The root key's detached JWS over the JCS form of the revocation without `proof`.

RootEndorsement.description: A previous root key's signature over its successor (spec 3.5 §7.2).

proof.description:
Detached JWS by the previous root over the JCS form of the new root without its
endorsement; its `kid` names the previous root.

endorsement.description: The previous root's signature over this root, after a rotation.

description:
`keys.json`: the site root key and its delegations (spec 3.5 §7.2).

Verification walks root → delegation → signature. A new root carries an endorsement by
the previous root, which moves to `retiredRoots`; recovery publishes a root through the
`_awp-root.<domain>` DNS TXT record, which a person changes. A compromised delegated key is
withdrawn by a root-signed revocation.

delegations.description: Root-signed delegations to release, card, receipt and payment keys.

retiredRoots.description: Earlier roots, kept so the delegations they signed still verify.

root.description: The site root key, which signs the contract and delegations.
